summary: Write ∏_τ det_τ^{c_τ} as a stacked determinant product and apply the invariance of the modular kernel.

steps.claim: The polynomial ∏_τ det_τ^{c_τ} equals a stacked determinant product (`twoSidedSubst_stackedDetProd`), and the modular theta kernel is invariant under rational points on the left (`modKernel_embFin_mul`, for both characters of weight −c).
steps.lean:
= detKernel n α c 𝔪 Ψ g := by simpa [stackedDetProd, stackedDet, ← det_submatrix_equiv_self (.symm
  (.emptySum ..)), ← modKernelBilin_apply, ← RingHom.map_det, ← RingHom.mapMatrix_apply,
  prod_ne_zero_iff] using! (twoSidedSubst_stackedDetProd
  (ι := (Fin <| c ·)) (.emptySum Empty n) 0 .. ▸ modKernel_embFin_mul h h _ _ _ 1 .. :)
